tags.name: Iam admin
tags.description: sdvico IAM Admin API used by CBVMS to manage IAM users and applications in place of the Logto Console. Authenticated with its own API resource, not the Management API.

IamAdminOAuth2.description: Machine-to-machine access token for the IAM Admin API. Request it with `grant_type=client_credentials` and `resource=https://<tenant-id>.logto.app/iam-admin`. A token issued for the Management API is rejected with 401.

scopes.iam-admin:users:read: Read IAM users, organizations and organization roles.
scopes.iam-admin:users:write: Create, update, suspend and delete IAM users and change their organizations.
scopes.iam-admin:apps:read: Read IAM applications grouped by system.

get.description: List every IAM user with their organizations and organization role titles, filtered, sorted and paginated. `lastSignInApplication` is the application of the user's latest successful authorization code exchange.

200.description: A page of users and the number of users matching the filters.

401.description: The access token is missing, invalid, or issued for another resource.

403.description: The token does not belong to a machine-to-machine application, lacks the `iam-admin:users:read` scope, or the application is not a member of an organization with `level = trung_uong`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on name, username and email; digits also match the phone number.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Only users who are members of this organization.

parameters.name: roleCode
parameters.description: Only users holding this organization role code (for example `TRUONG`). With `organizationId`, the role must be held in that organization.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `active`, `suspended`, or `no-organization` for users without any organization.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting from 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Users per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `lastSignIn` (newest first, never signed in last; default), `name`, or `createdAt` (newest first).

post.description: Create a user with a generated or given password and, optionally, a first organization with role codes. A generated temporary password is returned only in this response.

parameters.name: X-Iam-Actor
parameters.description: Username of the person acting in the calling system, URL-encoded. Required; recorded in the audit log.

parameters.name: X-Iam-Actor-Id
parameters.description: Stable ID of that person in the calling system. Optional; recorded in the audit log.

201.description: The created user and the temporary password, if generated.

400.description: The body is invalid or the `X-Iam-Actor` header is missing.

401.description: The access token is missing, invalid, or issued for another resource.

403.description: The token does not belong to a machine-to-machine application, lacks the `iam-admin:users:write` scope, or the application is not a member of an organization with `level = trung_uong`.

422.description: The username, email or phone number is already in use.

get.description: List applications of type Traditional, SPA, Native and machine-to-machine, grouped by `custom_data.system`. An application without a system forms its own system named after it.

post.description: Create 1 to 10 applications of one system in one call. Redirect URIs are validated as in the Logto Console (custom schemes for Native). Machine-to-machine applications may only receive the `machine:iam-sync` role. If any step fails, the applications already created are deleted. Client secrets are returned only in this response.
